item.title: Time-of-Day Immunochemotherapy Improves NSCLC Survival
item.description: Retrospective signals have suggested that treatment timing may influence immunochemotherapy efficacy, but prospective evidence has been limited. The post Time-of-Day Immunochemotherapy Improves NSCLC Survival appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Pandemic Linked to Reduced Cancer Survival Rates
item.description: A large US registry study found significantly worse one year cancer survival during 2020 and 2021, with an estimated 17 390 excess deaths linked to COVID-19 pandemic disruptions in care. The post Pandemic Linked to Reduced Cancer Survival Rates appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: COVID-19 Shifted Pediatric Flu Hospitalization Patterns in Children
item.description: Pediatric influenza hospitalizations shifted after the COVID-19 pandemic, with altered seasonality, virus type, and shorter stays. The post COVID-19 Shifted Pediatric Flu Hospitalization Patterns in Children appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Ketogenic Diet Shows Promise in Treatment-Resistant Depression
item.description: A UK trial suggests a ketogenic diet may modestly improve symptoms in treatment-resistant depression, but adherence remains a challenge. The post Ketogenic Diet Shows Promise in Treatment-Resistant Depression appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Immediate TB Therapy Fails to Improve HIV Sepsis Survival
item.description: Major trial finds immediate or high-dose TB treatment does not lower overall mortality in HIV-related sepsis, except in confirmed TB cases. The post Immediate TB Therapy Fails to Improve HIV Sepsis Survival appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Lifestyle and Mental Health Play Key Role in Adult Acne
item.description: A study of nearly 12,000 adults links sedentary behaviour, late sleep and psychological distress to higher adult acne risk, while regular exercise shows protective benefits. The post Lifestyle and Mental Health Play Key Role in Adult Acne appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: GLP-1RAs Monitored at 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: The 2026 Winter Olympics is the first at which GLP-1RAs will be monitored by the World Anti-Doping Agency, amid their growing use. The post GLP-1RAs Monitored at 2026 Winter Olympics appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Menstrual Cycle Awareness Lowest Among Under-25s
item.description: Participants under 25-years-old had the lowest rates of menstrual awareness in both cycle and period length in a 2026 cross-sectional analysis. The post Menstrual Cycle Awareness Lowest Among Under-25s appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency and Hidden Bronchiectasis Burden
item.description: New registry data show bronchiectasis affects multiple alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency genotypes, not just Pi*ZZ, with key implications for screening. The post Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency and Hidden Bronchiectasis Burden appeared first on European Medical Journal.
